tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Fly low over the person estimate (or a point) and hover there to look closely: raises confidence in a real person, lowers it for a decoy.

notes.description: optional: replaces your notes (your only memory across decisions); keep them short

tools.name: search_region
tools.description: Search a region with a standard pattern: lawnmower (parallel tracks over the whole region), expanding_square or sector (around the region centre or a datum). Lane spacing comes from the camera footprint at the altitude. Finishes when the pattern is flown; a sighting does not stop it (you decide).

notes.description: optional: replaces your notes (your only memory across decisions); keep them short

tools.name: takeoff
tools.description: Arm and climb straight up to the given altitude.

notes.description: optional: replaces your notes (your only memory across decisions); keep them short

tools.name: keep
tools.description: Let the running skill continue (or stay idle). Use when nothing needs to change.
